name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Unsloth NVFP4 Fast)
notes: Fast MoE with 3B active, Unsloth's NVFP4-Fast variant: every expert in NVFP4 (W4A4), which Unsloth puts at about 1.8x faster than their regular NVFP4 at a small cost in accuracy. On DGX Spark Unsloth advises the flashinfer_b12x MoE backend, never Marlin. The regular variant mixes NVFP4 and FP8 experts (the last eight layers), and b12x refuses FP8 MoE, so it fails to start with this flag (seen 2026-10-09). Fits on one Spark; with two it is split across both. Official vLLM image (0.29.1), no Ray. Not yet run here.
